name: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
summary: Public university on its own campus at Bellaterra, outside Barcelona; four bachelor's with complete English routes, from AI to tourism.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10), then Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Artificial intelligence across its fields: machine learning, natural language, computer vision, data analysis, robotics and multi-agent systems, with attention to ethics.
programmes.overview: The course builds the cognitive, mathematical and algorithmic foundations of reasoning and learning, then moves into natural language processing, computer vision, data analysis, robotics and autonomous agents, along with the ethical, legal and social side of using AI. Teaching is hands-on, with project work and case-based projects carried out with companies, and two nearby research centres, the Computer Vision Centre and the Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, are involved. Faculty come from several university departments. Graduates design and run AI applications in public administration, healthcare, finance and media, work in project management and consulting, or go into research.
programmes.ib: Taught in English; UAB expects a solid maths base and English at about B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration - English
programmes.about: Business administration taught in English with a professional focus: management, organisation and business English.
programmes.overview: The core is business management: accounting, marketing, finance, strategy and the organisation of companies, studied in small groups and with the aim of building business English alongside the managerial skills. In the fourth year you can complete an optional work placement in an English-speaking environment, and Erasmus and university exchanges are encouraged, especially to English-speaking countries. A final project closes the degree. Graduates work as financial directors, marketing managers, tax consultants, auditors, business consultants, investment analysts or entrepreneurs, and the degree also leads to public administration.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Economics - English
programmes.about: Four years of economics studied entirely in English, modelled on the Economics degrees of leading international universities.
programmes.overview: Economics is studied entirely in English over four years, with the aim of making sound decisions in public bodies and private businesses. In the final year you follow an itinerary that lets you specialise in the area that interests you most, and an optional work placement with English-speaking employers is available, arranged with Barcelona Activa. Exchanges run through Erasmus+, exchanges within Spain and the university's worldwide mobility programme, and a final project is required. Graduates work as economic and financial analysts, consultants, data analysts and policy designers in public administration, banking and companies, or go into research.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Tourism - English
programmes.about: Tourism taught 100% in English at an affiliated school on the Bellaterra campus, with specialisations and practice in an on-campus hotel.
programmes.overview: The degree covers the business management and organisation of tourist activities, destinations, services and resources, with attention to innovation and sustainability, and builds proficiency in several foreign languages. You choose one of three tracks: tourism business management, tourism marketing, planning and digitalisation, or hotel management. Practice includes hundreds of placement positions, work in a hotel on campus, Erasmus exchanges, work-experience placements and a double degree option with a university of applied sciences in Austria. A final project closes the degree. Graduates work in tourism and hospitality marketing, revenue management, events, travel platforms, product creation, consulting or their own ventures.
programmes.ib: B2 English recommended; no English test is required.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the 2026/27 admission mark was 5.000, the lowest possible access grade.

notes: UAB asks for no test of the language you will be taught in.
Tourism is run by an affiliated school and costs €94 a credit, far above the public price of €17.69.
The four "English and ..." combined degrees are only about half in English, so they are not listed here.
